additional_info.subject: RE: Webform_incident_SiCharge D_26-01-2026_SN: MP / S0 170003506 CRM:03275000021
additional_info.body:
Dear Hugo Camala,
Thank you for reaching out and providing the video. We have reviewed it and can see that the cable management system has a manufacturing defect and is not functioning correctly.
However, from the video, we are unable to identify which side of the unit is affected. Could you please provide a photo or a video clearly showing the face of the charger, highlighting the cable issue you mentioned?
This will help us better understand the problem and assist you more efficiently.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
